title: fraxinus pennsylvanica var. aucubifolia
intro: Fraxinus pennsylvanica var. aucubifolia, commonly known as Green Ash, is a deciduous tree species native to eastern North America. This tree is valued for its wood and bark, which have been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Green Ash include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Green Ash include its ability to stimulate circulation and reduce fever, while its bioactive constituents include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, and other flavonoids and phenolic acids.
